tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// rje btsun pa'i mnal lam bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ kho bo lo bco brgyad pa'i dus na g.yang bar nyi ma phyed tsam na/ gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam na mtshan brjod cig sngar thugs la bzung ba med pa dang*/ skye ba snga ma la bzung ba yin byas nas/ kha ton byas bas phyed tsam song tsa na mnal sad/ de'i dus na tshig 'ga' zhig 'don zhing 'dug gsungs/ lo bcu dgu lon pa'i tshe/ bla ma chen po sa skya pa bde bar gshegs pa'i sa g.yas su skya bo kha gdangs su/ g.yang bar nyi ma phyed tsam na gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam na/ mtshan brjod tshar gcig kha ton byas pa rmis gsungs/ de nas dgung lo nyi shu lon pa'i dus na/ gtsang po dron du g.yang bar nyi ma phyed tsam na tsog por gnyid du song 'dug pa'i rmi lam na/ rgya gar shar phyogs bha lend+ra na/ lho phyogs na ri chen po nags tshal byas pa cig yod/ de na ri khor chung zhig la nags tshal yod pa can zhig na dgon pa cig yod/ de na dge bsnyen sngags pa paṇḍi ta rgan po zhig yod pa la/ de'i byang na yul chen po gcig gi byang ngos su/ rgyal pos lha khang zhig brtsigs nas de'i rab gnas zhur byung ba la/ da nga rgas pas mi nus/ nga'i ming mu kha a nanta a thi bya ba sgo gong du bris la/ des rab gnas byas pa yin gyis la zhog des bar chad bsrung bar 'gyur ro// phyis nga'i slob ma paṇḍi ta che ba cig la rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyas par zhus shig gsungs nas/ bgres po de tshe'i dus byas so// de nas bya rgod phung po'i ri'i byang phyogs na btsun pa paṇḍi ta bgres po zhig tu 'dug pa de tshe'i dus byas nas au ḍyan gyi yul gyi byang ngos na ri brag chen po zhig yod pa la/ dgon pa cig 'dug pa de'i shod na lha khang yod pa de na 'khor rnams 'dug pa'i dpon po btsun pa paṇḍi ta bgres po zhig 'dug pa de 'das nas/

bod gcung pa'i yul na lung pa'i phu byang na yod pa mda' bye tshub ldang ba cig 'dug de nas gad gle zhig la shar nas 'dzegs nas byang du kha bltas pa/ gad them la 'dzegs pas dgon pa cig na/ lho phyogs na nag tshang byas pa/ byang phyogs na mchod khang yod pa/ de na gser gyi mchod rten cig yod/ nyal sa khyams stod khyams smad kyi mtshams na sngas shar du bstan pa cig yod/ de na sngags pa bgres po zhig yod pa des mtshan brjod mang du bshad/ de dus na bla ma chen po yang slob mar 'dug mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa sngags don rnams gzigs bya ba yin/ de'i dbu na/ thob dka' rgyu dang bcas pa yis// mtshan brjod don rnams bsdus pa yin// zhes bris pa yod de/ thob dka' 'bras bu'i rgyud/ rgyu rang gi rgyu rgyud/ spyod pas thabs kyi rgyud bstan te/ mtshan brjod rgyu thabs 'bras bu gsum gyis bstan te/ da lta dgon pa 'di na bzhugs te/ yi ge gshar ma la rtsa ba mtshal gyis bris pa cig 'dug pa dran/ bgres po 'das pa'i ro de yang de nyid na bzhag 'dug pa snyam byed/ spyir skye ba bdun tsam dran no byas pa rmis pa de/ khams pa sbal ston gam na 'dug pas gsungs pa rnams thos so// de nas mnal sad pa dang*/ sbal ston na re 'di 'dra gsung gin gda' byas nas/ dpe g.yengs pas pu sti 'dug tshigs bcad mi 'dug gsung*/ gcung pa'i de sdog ston lcu gu bya ba bla chen gyis tshad ma dang dbu ma'i stong thun chen mo bya ba gsan pa'i slob dpon zhig yod pa de 'das nas/ de'i dpe cha khur gcig sa skyar bskyal zhes a po dar ma lcam zer ro// yang dgung lo sum cu so bdun lon pa'i dus na/ tho rangs mnal du song ba'i tshe/ slob dpon rin po che sku gshegs nas/ ring por ma lon pa'i gdung gi gseb nas/ spang po che'i skad lta bu'i sgra zhig bar snang las 'thon nas/ khyod 'di nas byang phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams du ma 'das pa na/

'jig rten gyi khams gser gyi mdog can zhes bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od rnam par rtsen pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i bstan pa la/ de na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bsod nams mtha' yas zhes bya ba'i sras 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas zhes bya bar 'gyur ro// zhes sgra grag go zhes gsungs/ yang dgung lo zhe dgu pa'i dus na ru mtshams su snga res byon pa'i mnal lam du/ ri chen po zhig gi 'dab na khang pa chen po zhig gi 'og na/ mi mang po ku co dang zi long dang*/ 'ur sgra dang*/ tsheg sgra dang*/ ngud mo'i sgra grag pa/ steng khang na'ang mi mang po 'dug pa'i gseb na/ rje btsun rang yang 'dug pa la/ gzhan zhig tu gshegs par bzhed pas/ de na bla ma chen pos khyod la lam gyi yi ge bstan gyi gsungs nas dbang bzhi pa'i lam bstan/ slob dpon rin po che la zhus pas kyang dbang bzhi pa'i lam bstan nas khong gnyis mi snang bar gshegs so// de nas mi de rnams la/ rje pas kyang khyed rang srid pa'i rgya mtsho las pha rol tu 'gro ba yod na nga'i zla la shog cig lam rgyus nga la yod pa yin no zhes gsungs nas/ ri de'i nub ngos 'phred cig la byon pa dang*/ mi de rnams langs nas nga can du 'gro zer nas phal che ba rje btsun pa'i phyi na yar byung*/ shul du bag tsam langs nas/ de nyid du phung nge las/ de nas lam yangs pa cig 'dug pa'i 'og na g.yang sa chen po zhig 'dug pa la byang ngos su zhal gzigs te/ brag them zhig la 'dzegs nas/ 'di na yar shog gsungs pas brgya tsam phyin yar byung*/ gung ston nyeg po la sogs pa 'ga' zhag nub phyogs nyid na phar nyeg gung thang du 'gro zer nas song*/ mang po zhig nged kyis mi thar zer nas de nyid du phung nge las/ mi de rnams kyi nang nas phyag rgya chen po bya ba gcig rbab tu lhung zer nas/ kho bos/ ma shi'am byas pas ma shi tsam byung lags zer nas/

de nas mi de rnams la da khyed rang rnams ngas phyi nas yar khrid kyis gsungs nas dbang bzhi pa'i lam gsungs so// dpon g.yog rnams thon pa'i byang ngos na ri zur gzug po zhig 'dug shar phyogs na ri thang nyag cig 'dug pa la/ 'di na lam gnyis yod pa'i byang gi 'di bla chen gyis byang chub sems dpa' stag btang ba'i lam yin/ shar gyi 'di zhu byas dngos grub btang ba'i lam yin pas khyed rang lam 'di nas 'gro bar 'dod pa yod na song*/ ngas ni 'di la mi thar bas shar gyi lam 'di nas 'gro'o// khyed rang 'ong ba rnams kyang shog gsungs pas/ byang chub sems dpa' stag gi lam nas 'gro ba ma byung nas bzhi pa'i lam bstan/ de nas rje btsun nyid kyis brag gi them pa de la 'dzegs nas 'di na yar shog gsungs pas sum cu so lnga drug tsam byung ba la/ sum cu tsam gyis cung zad cig la ma thar ba la bzhi pa'i lam bstan nas phyi na yar shog gsungs te/ ska rags dang 'og gos med par na bza' ral gu ther ma rkyang pa yang nge ba cig gsol te/ ngo shes pa rga ston rdo rje grags dang*/ de min bzhi tsam gyis rje btsun gyi zhabs la sleb nas gos rkyang pa re dang bcas 'dug de nas thang nyag de'i steng nas sa phyogs shin tu nyams dga' ba cig yod do dgongs nas thang nyag der sleb pa dang mnal sad nas/ de rnams kyi don bsams pas khang pa'i 'og gi de rnams srid pa'i rgya mtsho yin te 'ong*/ steng na 'dug pa de rnams spyir 'khor tsam du 'dus pa yin snyam/ langs te 'dug pa de rnams dbang bskur tsam byas pa yin sems/ gung thang du song ba de rnams 'khor ba las cung zhig mi thon la/ rbab tu lhung ba de khos nga la khros nas dam tshig nyams shing ma shi zer ba de kho shi khar dam tshig gsos nas ngan song du mi ltung ba yin snyam/ lam khar lus pa de rnams kyis lam la 'bad rtsol cung zad byas pa yin te 'ong*/ lam gnyis ka'i khar bdun cu tsam las pa de rnams rtogs pa cung zad dang ldan pa yin par sems/

sum cu tsam gyis cung zad cig la ma thar ba de rnams snga ma bas kyang rtogs pa che ba yin te 'ong*/ nga'i zla la sleb pa de rnams kyis pha rol tu phyin pa nas bshad pa'i bzod pa tsam thob pa yin te 'ong*/ stag lta bu'i lus ma spangs par mchog thob pa'i slob ma mi yong bar dpyad/ zhu byas lta bu'i bzod pa thob pa lnga drug tsam yong bar 'dug nga rang yang de dag dang mnyam pa tsam yong bar 'dug snyam gsung*/ yang dgung lo drug cu rtsa gcig pa'i tshe/ mang mkhar slang rar dgun bzhugs pa'i dus su tho rangs mnal lam du nam mkha'i las gdugs shig brkyang nas sa la skas shig btsugs nas 'dug pa la/ mkha' 'gro ma yin snyam pa cig na re/ skas 'di la 'dzegs shig steng du thon pa dang mkha' spyod du gdan 'dren pa yin 'di ga na bsu bar sleb yod de rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa 'di yin zer nas snyan na rol mo'i sgra grag cing 'dug pa la/ mkha' spyod pa la ngas khe che rgyu med/ da dung 'di na don che bas 'dir sdod gsung ngo*// yang phyi rol ne'u gsing zhig gi steng na gser gyi kor kor 'phang lo tsam zhig 'dug pa la 'di'i steng du gdan things la bzhugs shig gdan btegs nas mkha' spyod du 'gro ba yin no zer ba la/ da dung 'di na don che bas 'dir sdod gsungs pa dang mnal sad do// spyir rje ba la mnal lam gyi dus su bla ma rnams dang mjal zhing*/ the tshom du ma sel bar byas pa yin zhing*/ yang dgung lo drug cu rtsa bdun pa'i dus na ston zla tha chungs dbyug pa'i tshes drug 'das pa'i tho rangs mnal lam du/ bla ma chen po dang mjal nas dri ba dang*/ de'i lam gyi the tshom du ma sel bar mdzad nas yang bla ma'i zhal nas khyod kyis bsam pa la longs sku dang sprul sku gang bzang gsungs pa la/ spyir rgyal ba khyu mchog ces bya ba gzhan don byed pa la sprul sku rang gtso bor snang yang*/ ngo bo la sangs rgyas gcig gi rnam 'phrul la bzang ngan med la/

gal te bzang ngan du blta na/ sprul byed lags pas longs sku rang bzang ba ma lags sam/ zhes zhus pas bu de tsug yin gyi/ khyod kyis go 'dug gsungs so// yang bla ma'i g.yas phyogs na kye'i rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor sprin nam na bun nam/ 'ja' tshon gyi rnam par 'dug pa mthong ba dang*/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod btsun pa gyis gsungs pa la/ nga bdag lo bdun cu la sna gtad/ mkhan po ran pa na lo brgyad cu tho phyir 'gro bar gda' bas/ gzhan don bgyid par rang 'phyis nas 'chi bar mi gda' ye/ ma 'phyis kyang mkhan slob rang yang mos pa mi rnyed par gda'/ zhes zhus pas/ bla ma'i g.yon ngos na sprul sku shākya thub pa la/ nyan thos kun shes kauṇḍi n+ya la sogs pa lnga/ shā ri'i bu dang*/ mau 'gal gyi bu dang*/ kun dga' bo ste brgyad kyis bskor ba'ang sprin nam 'ja' tshon ltar mthong ba dang*/ der bla ma'i zhal nas sdom pa len na 'di la blangs pas chog de min na 'di tsug byas kyang chog pa yin te sprul sku 'di dang dges rdor zhal brgyad pa 'di ngo bo gcig yin/ nyan thos brgyad dang*/ lha mo brgyad ngo bo gcig yin/ dge slong ma grags 'dzin sa spyod/ sgra gcan 'dzin mkha' spyod ma yin pas/ lha dgu po'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid las sdom pa blangs kyang chog mod gsungs pas/ de'ang de tsug gda' zhes zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas 'o na khyod bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong ba gang bzang snyam gsungs pas/ de dag dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dngos mthong na bzang lags te/ da lta zhal mthong ba'i skal ba mi gda' ba/ zhes bla ma bzhugs bzhin du zhal mjal ba'i skal ba mi gda' gsung ba snyam byed pa cig byung ngo*// de nas bla ma'i zhal nas da khong pa gnyis la khyad med pas btsun pa byed na'ang*/ mkhan po'i byed lugs shes par mi 'dug gam gsungs pas/ gda' zhes zhus pas/ 'o na khyod btsun pa byed na mkhan po gang la zhu/

dbang bskur zhu na gang la zhu gsung ba snyam byed pas/ bdag btsun pa byed na mkhan por gyur pa dang*/ dbang bskur zhu ba'i bla mar gyur pa ni bla chen nyid lags so zhes zhus pas/ de de bzhin no gsungs nas/ bla chen nyid la 'khor byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad 'dug pa snyam byed pa dang*/ de'ang g.yas g.yon gyi longs sku lha dgu dang*/ sprul sku lha dgu/ bla ma la thim par mthong*/ bla mas chos kyi sgro 'dogs mang du bcad nas/ rigs kyi bu chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid 'di ltar yin mod gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur pa dang mnal sad do// gzhan yang slob dpon rin po che dang mjal nas lan mang du chos zhus pa rmis gsung ngo*// rje btsun chen po'i mnal lam bris pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
